_comment: The knob registry: one card per tunable, so every setting is discoverable, typed and
documented in one place - including every agent's model and effort pin, which would
otherwise hide in frontmatter and drift.
checkctl's config_registry_lint enforces two tiers: ERROR when a card points at a file
or key that does not exist (a dead card is worse than no card), WARN when a scalar in a
watched file has no card (incompleteness informs, it does not block).

entries.title: Distribution generators
entries.description: Run the home-repo-only generators (demo_build, dist_build) in POLISH. True only in dot-claude-iff's own source repo: in an adopting project they would package and publish that project's private .claude/. Kits ship this false; an absent key reads as false.

entries.title: Ritual ticket lifetime
entries.description: Minutes a ritual ticket stays fresh. The prompt hook (hooks/ritual-ticket.sh) writes .claude/state/ritual-ticket.json when the user's own prompt starts with /project-memory or /adopt; checkctl run opens or continues a ritual only while it is fresh, and checkctl complete needs it and consumes it. Anything but a positive number reads as the default. No flag or environment variable skips the ticket.

entries.title: Push policy
entries.description: Whether PUBLISH pushes after committing. always: push without asking. ask (default): one question per ritual. never: commit only.

entries.title: Visibility of .claude/
entries.description: tracked: .claude/ and .claude-iff/ are committed with the project; the managed .gitignore block ignores only per-user and derived files. ignored: both trees stay in this checkout and never reach git; publish a clean copy with distctl.py export. /adopt asks once (recommends ignored when the remote is public); apply a change with distctl.py gitignore --apply. Absent reads as tracked; kits ship tracked.

entries.title: Export include list
entries.description: Globs (relative to the repo root, fnmatch style, a trailing / names a folder) of .claude/ and .claude-iff/ files distctl.py export may publish. Empty publishes nothing from either tree. Only narrows: the hard-coded floor (state, tasks, research, worktrees, private reference, STATUS, logs, lessons, the record surface, local settings, env files) always wins. Kits ship it empty.

entries.title: Vault snapshots
entries.description: Take a git-bundle + chat snapshot into RECORD_ROOT/vault at PUBLISH.

entries.title: Vault retention count
entries.description: How many snapshots to keep. Older ones are reported as prunable, never auto-deleted.

entries.title: Snapshot disk guard
entries.description: Refuse a snapshot unless free disk is at least this multiple of the estimated size.

entries.title: Snapshot includes chat transcripts
entries.description: Include ~/.claude/projects/<slug>/ transcripts in the vault snapshot.

entries.title: Guide and rule size target
entries.description: context_health warns when one guide (CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md) or rule (.claude/rules/*.md) is longer than this many lines. 200 follows Claude Code's own guidance: a longer file costs context on every load and is followed less reliably.

entries.title: Always-on context budget
entries.description: context_health warns when everything that loads at launch (the root guide, its @imports, rules without paths:) adds up past this many lines. Move what only one part of the tree needs into a folder guide or a scoped rule.

entries.title: Record root override
entries.description: Absolute path for RECORD_ROOT. null uses the sibling default <parent>/<repo>_claude_iff.

entries.title: Secrets scan allowlist
entries.description: Repo-relative path prefixes or globs the secrets_placement check skips (vendored fixtures, a stack that commits its .env on purpose). For one line, prefer an inline iff:allow-secret comment.

entries.title: Capture enabled
entries.description: Master switch for the capture lane. Off means no spool writes at all.

entries.title: Capture breadth
entries.description: false: the lean event set in capture_events. true: every hook event (heavier; the source system measured ~21 MB/session).

entries.title: Raw retention
entries.description: 0 keeps raw forever (the default: raw is the agent's ground truth). A positive value expires sealed raw older than N days.

entries.title: Compact sealed raw
entries.description: gzip sealed raw files (~10x smaller) instead of leaving them plain.

entries.title: Record size warning
entries.description: CHECK reports the record size loudly above this many MB. Reporting, never deleting.

entries.title: Copy transcripts verbatim
entries.description: Copy transcript files into RECORD_ROOT/raw/transcripts as the completeness backstop. Segments stay metadata-only either way.

entries.title: Ingest file cap
entries.description: 0 means no cap. A positive value bounds a single ingest run (cursors make the next run resume).

entries.title: Retrospective analysis provider
entries.description: Which model service obsctl analyze calls over the raw record. none disables it.

entries.title: Analysis model
entries.description: Model id for the analysis provider.

entries.title: Analysis base URL
entries.description: OpenAI-compatible endpoint for the analysis engine, e.g. https://openrouter.ai/api/v1 or http://localhost:11434/v1 (Ollama). Key comes from env ANALYZE_API_KEY, never from config.

entries.title: Analysis parallelism
entries.description: How many chunks are sent to the analysis endpoint concurrently.

entries.title: Analysis call timeout
entries.description: Per-chunk HTTP timeout in seconds.

entries.title: Analysis batch size
entries.description: How many raw events go into one model call.

entries.title: Billing mode
entries.description: api: per-token dollar cost applies and the price table prices it. subscription: usage is included in a plan, dollar cost reads 'in plan' and the empty-table warning goes quiet. Token counts are tracked either way.

entries.title: Console bind host
entries.description: Always a loopback address. The console serves live state; it must never be reachable off-box.

entries.title: Console port
entries.description: Port for console.py. "auto" (the shipped default) derives a stable port from the repo folder name (7100-7899) so projects on one machine never collide; an explicit integer is a decided-once override.

entries.title: System monitor
entries.description: Serve live CPU/RAM/GPU/VRAM samples at /live/system.json and render the System strip on the NOW tab. Live-only: samples never enter the built payload, the record, or the published demo. Kits ship this off.

entries.title: Console autostart
entries.description: Start console.py from the SessionStart hook, guarded by a pidfile.

entries.title: Poll interval (active)
entries.description: Client poll cadence while the heartbeat is fresh.

entries.title: Poll interval (idle)
entries.description: Client poll cadence when the heartbeat is stale.

entries.title: Active window
entries.description: Heartbeat age below which the session counts as active.

entries.title: Anatomist model
entries.description: The .claude anatomy expert: reads components, traces relations, maintains cards, implements approved evolution changes.

entries.title: Retro-analyst model
entries.description: Evidence-gated evolution proposals, propose-only (tool-restricted, cannot write).

entries.title: Verifier model
entries.description: Adversarial claim checker; inherits the main session's model so it is never weaker than the work it checks.

entries.title: Builder model
entries.description: Implements one task card in a git worktree in the fableous-orchestrated mode; the lead reviews and merges. Pinned to the strongest builder so the lead reviews a diff instead of redoing it.

entries.title: Builder effort
entries.description: Reasoning effort for the builder: high, because a builder carries a whole task card to a green suite on its own and a shallow pass costs a second dispatch.

entries.title: Scout model
entries.description: Read-only research for the lead (surveys, lookups, quick checks); a cheaper model, because finding facts costs tokens the lead should keep for decisions.

entries.title: Scout effort
entries.description: Reasoning effort for the scout: medium, enough to search well; a scout reports facts and leaves the reasoning about them to the lead.

entries.title: Delegation nudge threshold
entries.description: fableous-orchestrated only: after this many lead Write/Edit calls on code (not .claude/state/, .claude/tasks/, docs/ or .md/.rst/.txt files) with no sub-agent dispatched, the post-write hook hands the lead one advisory reminder to delegate, then counts again. 0 turns it off. Never blocks.

entries.title: Handoff rerun timeout
entries.description: Seconds each recorded test may run under `checkctl handoff <id> --run`. A timeout is a FAIL for that test.

entries.title: Activity pulse throttle
entries.description: Every mode: the policy gate (after its decision, on every Write/Edit/Bash/PowerShell call) and the capture hook on SubagentStart/SubagentStop rewrite state/heartbeat.json as 'working' once it is older than this many seconds, so 'last activity' stays true through a multi-hour turn. A Stop hook's 'turn ended' is superseded on the next call. 0 turns it off. Telemetry: a broken pulse never changes a gate decision.

entries.title: Periodic progress report
entries.description: guided-solo and fableous-orchestrated only: once this many minutes have passed since the last report, the post-write hook hands the lead the compact `statectl progress` block with one instruction, post it to the user as is. Advisory, main session only, never in freestyle, skipped when there is no milestone or no task. 0 turns it off.

entries.title: Brainstorm branch count
entries.description: How many frames /adhd picks per run, so how many isolated Diverge branches run in parallel. Cost grows linearly with it.

entries.title: Brainstorm frames
entries.description: The cognitive-frame catalogue /adhd picks from: each frame has a name, a vantage prompt and tags (code, design, general, wild). Must hold at least branch_count frames, at least one tagged wild.

entries.title: Brainstorm branch model
entries.description: Agent-tool model for every Diverge branch: a model alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, ...) or inherit (omit the per-call model, run on the session's model).

entries.title: Brainstorm critic model
entries.description: Agent-tool model for the critic pass and the deepen calls: a model alias (sonnet, opus, haiku, ...) or inherit (the default, so the judge is never weaker than the session).

entries.title: Phase contracts
entries.description: Per lifecycle phase (plan, build, review, deploy): a label, a contract of at most five lines printed at session start in the guided-solo and fableous-orchestrated modes, and the name of the exit check (bound in checkctl.PHASE_EXITS) that statectl phase runs before leaving it.

entries.title: Build exit test timeout
entries.description: Seconds each task's Test command may run in the build exit check (checkctl phase-exit --from build). A timeout is a FAIL for that task. Generous by default: a Test may be a whole suite.

entries.title: Deploy drift ignore list
entries.description: Paths the ritual's deploy_drift check does not list as new work while in the deploy phase: 'dir/' entries match that directory anywhere in a path, other entries are file-name or path globs. Defaults cover tests, docs and the system's own bookkeeping.
